provenance.scope: DeepSeek-V2-Lite pretrained embedding and first MLA attention layer only. No feed-forward, later layers, LM head, or generated prediction.

operations.label: Token embedding
operations.description: The selected prompt uses actual pretrained embedding rows, then the first layer’s RMSNorm.

operations.label: Query projection
operations.description: This Lite checkpoint projects directly from 2048D to 16 query heads. Each 192D head is split into 128 content coordinates and 64 rotary coordinates; there is no query low-rank bottleneck in this checkpoint.

operations.label: Compress K/V
operations.description: A shared projection creates a 512D latent and a separate 64D positional key. The normalized latent can be cached rather than full per-head K and V.

operations.label: Decoupled RoPE
operations.description: Each head has 128 content-query coordinates plus 64 rotary coordinates. A single rotated key is shared by all 16 heads. This checkpoint uses its trained YaRN configuration.

operations.label: Expand latent to heads
operations.description: For this reference forward pass, the shared 512D latent expands into 16 content-key and value heads. Optimized inference may absorb these linear maps into surrounding projections.

operations.label: Causal latent attention
operations.description: Attention uses content and positional dot products together. Each matrix is recorded from the actual first-layer forward pass; future positions are masked.
operations.formula: Aₕ = softmax((qₕ kₕᵀ) × scale + causal mask); oₕ = Aₕ vₕ

operations.label: Attention output
operations.description: The 16 value-head outputs are concatenated and projected back to 2048D. This trace stops before the feed-forward layer; it is not a full-model next-token prediction.
operations.formula: y = Wᴼ concat(o₁,…,o₁₆); residual = embedding + y
